layer "places" extent=4096 keys=[active name note rank score]
  id=1 POINT tags={active=bool(true) name=string("centre") note=string("centre note") rank=uint(10) score=double(1.5)} [(2048,2048)]
  id=2 POINT tags={active=bool(false) name=string("probe") note=string("probe note") rank=uint(20) score=double(2.25)} [(2248,1416)]
  id=3 POINT tags={active=bool(true) name=string("nulltag") rank=uint(30) score=double(3.75)} [(3072,1024)]
layer "roads" extent=4096 keys=[lanes name]
  id=1 LINESTRING tags={lanes=uint(2) name=string("crossing")} [(3072,2048) (4352,2048)]
  id=2 LINESTRING tags={lanes=uint(4) name=string("inside")} [(1024,1024) (2048,1024)]
